summary: Group Extras (rename/add/remove/leave) end-to-end tested. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests pass covering owner-only permissions, friend-only add filter, self-remove 400, non-member 404, non-owner 403, ownership transfer on owner leave, and full deletion of group + messages on last leave. Frontend: verified both owner and non-owner views of /group/manage — gear icon (testID group-manage) navigates correctly, owner sees editable name + Save + Add friends + Remove X + Leave, non-owner sees read-only name + members list + Leave only. Rename persisted end-to-end and add-friend flow updated MEMBERS count in UI. NOTE: Discovered a pre-existing (unrelated) 500 bug in GET /api/groups — 'can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes' at server.py:2257 — this is NOT part of the new extras feature but is user-visible on the inbox groups list; reporting for main agent.

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error — TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes at server.py:2257 (out.sort key uses group_messages.last_at which may be naive while datetime.min is aware). Triggered when member1 has groups with messages. Pre-existing bug, unrelated to Group Extras feature but blocks the groups tab in Inbox. RCA: some group_messages.created_at values were stored offset-naive; sort lambda 't.get("last_at") or datetime.min.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)' fails when last_at is naive. Fix: wrap last_at with a normalizer that forces tzinfo=timezone.utc before sorting, or store all created_at as aware UTC.

rca_of_issue: The 500 on /api/groups is caused by sort key `t.get('last_at') or datetime.min.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)` at server.py:2257 mixing offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes. Some group_messages documents have `created_at` without tzinfo, so their last_at flows through the sort naive and comparison against the aware fallback throws TypeError. Reproduction: login as any member with an existing group+messages, GET /api/groups → 500. Fix: (1) normalize last_at in the sort key, e.g. `lambda t: (t.get('last_at').astimezone(timezone.utc) if t.get('last_at') and t['last_at'].tzinfo else (t.get('last_at').replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) if t.get('last_at') else datetime.min.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)))`, and (2) ensure every insert to group_messages uses now_utc() (already does — but likely older seed docs are naive). Backfill: `db.group_messages.update_many({'created_at': {'$type': 'date'}}, ...)` to add tzinfo, or coerce in the read path.
